purpose: Minimal authorized/public metadata acquisition/import plan needed to close Step-17 gates; no data acquisition performed.

tasks.preferred_source: licensed I/B/E/S or official newswire/issuer archive with first-public-release timestamps
tasks.fallback: SEC EDGAR ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME as corroborating proxy only; does not by itself close G1

tasks.preferred_source: authorized NYSE Daily TAQ Master history covering all required market dates
tasks.benefit: One daily security-master source can provide Listed Exchange and daily Shares Outstanding for the required symbols.

tasks.preferred_source: SEC XBRL/companyfacts effective-dated shares-outstanding facts if Daily TAQ Master shares are unavailable
tasks.constraint: Only facts already public by the target date are eligible; future-filed facts are rejected.

tasks.preferred_source: authorized point-in-time earnings/event calendar plus pre-event matching covariates
tasks.research_only_helper: vgreg/hacked_earnings_jfe SampleFirms can enumerate retrospective same-day earnings candidates but cannot alone close the point-in-time gate.
